coverage_method: Exact projected area intersection with available NASADEM tile footprints in EPSG:6933.

terrain_status_definitions.valid_land: Land measurements with nearly complete source-tile coverage.
terrain_status_definitions.water_only: Source tile available, but no land elevation measurement.
terrain_status_definitions.no_source_tile: No NASADEM source tile covers this cell.
terrain_status_definitions.missing_land_measurement: Source tile present but valid terrain measurement unavailable.
